/Connector Catalog/Microsoft Excel/Actions

Actions

The Microsoft Excel connector exposes the following clients:

Available clients:

ClientPurpose
ClientWork with Excel workbooks stored in OneDrive for Business and SharePoint through the Microsoft Graph v1.0 API, including worksheets, ranges, tables, charts, PivotTables, named items, comments and workbook sessions

Client​

The Client connects to the Microsoft Graph v1.0 API and acts on behalf of the signed-in user. Every operation identifies the workbook by the ID of the drive that holds it (driveId) and the ID of the workbook file in that drive (driveItemId).

Configuration​

ConnectionConfig

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
authhttp:BearerTokenConfig|OAuth2RefreshTokenGrantConfigRequiredAuthentication configuration. OAuth2RefreshTokenGrantConfig takes the client ID, client secret, refresh token and refreshUrl, which defaults to https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token
httpVersionhttp:HttpVersionhttp:HTTP_2_0HTTP version used by the client
http1Settingshttp:ClientHttp1Settings{}HTTP/1.x protocol settings
http2Settingshttp:ClientHttp2Settings{}HTTP/2 protocol settings
timeoutdecimal30Maximum wait time in seconds for a response
forwardedstring"disable"Handling of forwarded/x-forwarded header
followRedirectshttp:FollowRedirectsOptionalRedirection configuration
poolConfighttp:PoolConfigurationOptionalConnection pool configuration
cachehttp:CacheConfig{}HTTP caching configuration
compressionhttp:Compressionhttp:COMPRESSION_AUTOaccept-encoding header handling
circuitBreakerhttp:CircuitBreakerConfigOptionalCircuit breaker configuration
retryConfighttp:RetryConfigOptionalRetry configuration
cookieConfighttp:CookieConfigOptionalCookie configuration
responseLimitshttp:ResponseLimitConfigs{}Inbound response size limits
secureSockethttp:ClientSecureSocketOptionalSSL/TLS options
proxyhttp:ProxyConfigOptionalProxy server options
socketConfighttp:ClientSocketConfig{}Client socket configuration
validationbooleantrueEnables inbound payload validation
laxDataBindingbooleantrueTreats nil values as optional during data binding

The client's serviceUrl argument defaults to https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0.

Initializing the client​

import ballerinax/microsoft.excel;

configurable string clientId = ?;
configurable string clientSecret = ?;
configurable string refreshToken = ?;
configurable string refreshUrl = ?;
configurable string driveId = ?;
configurable string driveItemId = ?;

final excel:Client excelClient = check new ({
    auth: {clientId, clientSecret, refreshToken, refreshUrl}
});

Operations​

Workbook and application​

getWorkbook

Retrieves the workbook object of an Excel file.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
driveIdstringYesID of the drive that holds the workbook
driveItemIdstringYesID of the workbook file (drive item) in the drive
headersGetWorkbookHeadersNoRequest headers. Set workbookSessionId to run the request in a workbook session
dollarExpandstring[]NoExpand related entities
dollarSelectstring[]NoSelect properties to be returned

Returns: Workbook&#124;error

Sample code:

excel:Workbook result = check excelClient->getWorkbook(driveId, driveItemId);

Sample response:

{
  "application": {
    "calculationMode": "Automatic"
  },
  "functions": {}
}

Returns: Workbook&#124;error

Sample code:

{

headersListWorksheetsHeadersNoRequest headers. Set workbookSessionId to run the request in a workbook session
dollarSkipintNoSkip the first n items

Ranges​

getCell

Retrieves the range that contains a single cell, by its row and column number.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
driveIdstringYesID of the drive that holds the workbook
driveItemIdstringYesID of the workbook file (drive item) in the drive
workbookWorksheetIdstringYesID or name of the worksheet
rowdecimalYesZero-based row number of the cell
columndecimalYesZero-based column number of the cell
headersGetCellHeadersNoRequest headers. Set workbookSessionId to run the request in a workbook session

Returns: RangeResponse&#124;error

Sample code:

excel:RangeResponse result = check excelClient->getCell(driveId, driveItemId, "Sheet1", 1, 2);

Sample response:

{
  "columnHidden": false,
  "address": "Sheet1!A1:C2",
  "hidden": false,
  "formulas": [
    ["Date", "Category", "Amount"],

  ],
  "values": [
    ["Date", "Category", "Amount"],

  ],
  "columnCount": 3,
  "rowHidden": false,
  "cellCount": 6,
  "numberFormat": [
    ["General", "General", "General"],
    ["yyyy-mm-dd", "General", "0.00"]
  ],
  "columnIndex": 0,
  "rowIndex": 0,
  "valueTypes": [
    ["String", "String", "String"],
    ["String", "String", "Double"]
  ],
  "rowCount": 2
}

Sessions and asynchronous results​

closeSession

Closes a workbook session. Pass the session ID in the workbookSessionId header.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
driveIdstringYesID of the drive that holds the workbook
driveItemIdstringYesID of the workbook file (drive item) in the drive
headersCloseSessionHeadersNoRequest headers. Set workbookSessionId to run the request in a workbook session

Returns: error?

Sample code:

check excelClient->closeSession(driveId, driveItemId);
createSession

Creates a workbook session. Pass the returned session ID as workbookSessionId in the headers of later calls to run them in the same session.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
driveIdstringYesID of the drive that holds the workbook
driveItemIdstringYesID of the workbook file (drive item) in the drive
payloadCreateSessionRequestYesWhether the session persists its changes to the file
headersmap<string|string[]>NoRequest headers

Returns: SessionInfoResponse&#124;error

Sample code:

excel:SessionInfoResponse result = check excelClient->createSession(driveId, driveItemId,
    {persistChanges: true});

Sample response:

{
  "persistChanges": true,
  "id": "cluster=US5&session=25.SN2PEPF00002F6B.A116.1.V24"
}

Refreshes a workbook session so that it doesn't expire. Pass the session ID in the workbookSessionId header.

NameTypeRequiredDescription
driveIdstringYesID of the drive that holds the workbook
